NaturalIngredients.badge: From Danube Plains to Global Ports
NaturalIngredients.title: Only Pure, High-Grade Natural Commodities
NaturalIngredients.p1: Welcome to Sopreden Trading – your premier gateway for high-purity sunflower commodities, certified palm oil fractions, and select pumpkin seeds. Sourced directly from Bulgaria's fertile North-East Danube agricultural heartland, our products meet rigorous European food safety and industrial standards.
NaturalIngredients.p2: We specialize in precision-graded sunflower kernels designed for diverse industrial applications. From bakery-grade cuts tailored for commercial baking and birdfeed, to hand-selected confectionery Jumbo and XXL kernels that command high value in snack manufacturing.
NaturalIngredients.p3: Our sustainable palm oil portfolio serves both the confectionery, dairy, and snack food sectors, as well as the rapidly expanding bio-diesel and technical lubrication industries. Furthermore, our flagship 'Lady Nails' pumpkin seeds are prized across culinary and dietary markets.
NaturalIngredients.p4: Every single metric ton traded by Sopreden undergoes meticulous optical grading, lab moisture testing, and stringent quality control, guaranteeing exceptional purity and traceability from harvest to container loading.

Products.title: Our Agricultural Products
Products.subtitle: Meticulously processed and sorted to exact industrial specifications. Available in 25kg paper/poly bags, big bags, flexitanks, and bulk vessel shipments.

pumpkin-seeds.title: Pumpkin Seeds ('Lady Nails')
pumpkin-seeds.description: We specialize in the renowned 'Lady Nails' variety. Characterized by uniform elongated shape, rich nutty aroma, and high zinc/magnesium density, widely used across artisanal baking, savory snacks, and health nutrition.
pumpkin-seeds.longDescription: Sopreden's 'Lady Nails' pumpkin seeds represent the pinnacle of European seed cultivation. Grown in nutrient-rich soils, each batch is mechanically dehulled, optically sorted by laser color cameras, and packed in nitrogen-flushed or heavy-duty woven bags. High in natural unsaturated fatty acids and essential minerals, they are ideal for roasted snack lines, muesli blends, and cold-pressed botanical oils.

sunflower-kernels.title: Sunflower Kernels (Bakery & Confectionery)
sunflower-kernels.description: Available in Bakery Grade and distinguished Confectionery Grade (Jumbo and XXL). Expertly sorted, 99.9% clean, uniform color, and free from bitter aftertaste.
sunflower-kernels.longDescription: Our flagship sunflower kernels are celebrated among European master bakers and multinational snack conglomerates. Sourced from high-yielding oil and confection hybrid varieties, seeds undergo multi-stage hulling, aspiration, gravity separation, and Sortex optical sorting. The result is pure, undamaged kernels with exceptional shelf life and crisp texture.

sunflower-chips.title: Sunflower Chips (Broken Fraction)
sunflower-chips.description: A high-nutrient broken kernel derivative obtained during the dehulling process. Rich in essential oils and protein, serving as the gold standard for premium birdfeed and avian nutrition.
sunflower-chips.longDescription: Sunflower chips consist of clean, broken sunflower meat separated during the mechanical dehulling phase. Because they contain the full caloric, lipid, and protein profile of intact kernels at a favorable price point, they are highly sought after by commercial feed mills and bird-food packagers worldwide.

stripped-sunflower.title: Stripped Sunflower Seeds
stripped-sunflower.description: Offering a versatile range of striped varieties: from Pioneer and Badger for avian care, to Jumbo and XXL sizes for in-shell roasting, salting, and gourmet snacking.
stripped-sunflower.longDescription: Bulgarian striped sunflower seeds are famous for their bold contrasting stripes, plump kernel fill, and thin easily cracked hulls. We supply both calibrated feed grades (ideal for wild birds and parrots) and jumbo-calibrated snacking grades that retain unmatched crispiness when roasted.

sunflower-crude-oil.title: Sunflower Crude & Refined Oil
sunflower-crude-oil.packaging: Flexitanks (24 MT), ISO Tanks, Bulk Vessels
sunflower-crude-oil.description: High-yield, golden first-press crude oil and fully refined deodorized sunflower oil. Suitable for culinary frying, food packaging, and industrial processing.
sunflower-crude-oil.longDescription: Extracted through modern expeller pressing followed by solvent recovery, Sopreden's crude sunflower oil boasts low phosphatides, clean golden hue, and high smoke stability. We supply both crude oil for destination refineries and fully refined edible oil for bottling and commercial food production.

palm-oil.title: Versatile Palm Oil Solutions
palm-oil.grade: RBD Palm Oil, Olein & Stearin Fractions
palm-oil.description: Responsibly sourced, RSPO-traceable palm oil solutions. Tailored for food manufacturing (confectionery, dairy, popcorn, roasting) and technical bio-diesel production.
palm-oil.longDescription: Sopreden delivers a dependable supply chain of refined, bleached, and deodorized (RBD) palm oil products and specialized fractions. Our products meet strict sustainability criteria and provide consistent crystallization and melting behavior essential for chocolate spreads, commercial bakery fats, and clean-burning bio-diesel.

new-website-launch.title: Sopreden Launches Next-Gen Digital Trading Hub & Interactive Platform
new-website-launch.excerpt: Sopreden Trading unveils a premier digital trading platform: featuring instant multi-commodity RFQ quotation, interactive facility tours, live dehulling footage, and seamless multilingual trading desk support.
new-website-launch.content:
Today marks a transformative milestone for Sopreden Trading with the official unveiling of our next-generation digital trading platform. Engineered from the ground up for international grain traders, food manufacturers, and commercial brokers, the new portal delivers an unprecedented standard of transparency, speed, and market utility.

Why is the new platform a game-changer? First and foremost is our all-new Instant Commodity RFQ Builder. Instead of waiting days for back-and-forth emails, commodity buyers can select products, volume, packaging specifications (from 25kg multi-wall bags to 1000kg Big Bags or bulk flexitanks), and request exact delivery terms (FOB Port of Varna, CIF Mediterranean/European terminals, or DAP overland) with rapid trade desk response.

Second, the site introduces complete transparency into our processing capabilities. Prospective clients can explore our boutique Silistra dehulling plant with live production footage, detailed technical flowcharts of our 6-stage centrifugal impact line, and exact Sortex optical purity metrics (99.9% whole-kernel guarantee).

Finally, the entire experience is built on a state-of-the-art Next.js performance architecture, delivering sub-second page transitions, full mobile responsiveness, seamless multilingual support across 7 European languages, and instant direct WhatsApp communication with our live trading desk in Silistra.

new-dehulling-plant-operational.title: New High-Precision Dehulling Plant in Silistra Operating Since July
new-dehulling-plant-operational.excerpt: Our state-of-the-art boutique seed dehulling and optical Sortex sorting facility in Silistra has reached full commercial speed, delivering 99.9% pure sunflower and pumpkin kernels for European manufacturers.
new-dehulling-plant-operational.content:
Sopreden Trading is proud to announce that our newly expanded, high-precision seed dehulling and optical sorting facility in Silistra, Bulgaria has been in continuous commercial operation since July 2026. This purpose-built plant represents a major leap forward in European seed processing, catering specifically to human-grade bakery and confectionery standards.

With a daily intake capacity of 40 to 60 metric tons of raw oilseeds and pumpkin harvests, the plant yields 20 to 30 metric tons of 99.9% pure, undamaged kernels every 24 hours. Located strategically in the heart of the Dobrudzha agricultural basin directly on the Danube river, freshly harvested seeds arrive at our intake silos within hours of cutting, eliminating oxidative rancidity and preserving natural moisture balance.

Unlike industrial mega-crushers that pulverize raw seeds solely for crude oil yield, Sopreden’s facility uses gentle kinetic centrifugal impact rotors combined with closed-circuit air aspiration and bi-chromatic Sortex laser sorting. This engineering sequence guarantees an exceptionally low broken count (< 3%), zero hull contamination, and intact kernel geometry.

In addition to producing our own premium bakery and confectionery kernels, the Silistra facility is actively taking on contract processing (tolling) for partner agricultural producers. Furthermore, operating as a zero-waste facility, all separated outer hulls are immediately compressed on-site into high-density 18 MJ/kg eco-fuel pellets.

benefits-seeds.title: Discover the Benefits of Sopreden’s Premium Seed Selection
benefits-seeds.excerpt: In the world of agriculture and food production, seed quality dictates the entire value chain. Sopreden offers an elite selection that commands high acclaim across European food manufacturing.
benefits-seeds.content:
In the world of agriculture and modern food production, the biological and physical quality of seeds plays a decisive role. Sopreden, a name synonymous with purity and trade reliability, offers a premium seed selection that stands out for its high oil content, low aflatoxin levels, and remarkable uniformity.

From our prized 'Lady Nails' pumpkin seeds—loaded with plant-based protein, dietary fiber, and essential minerals—to our calibrated bakery-grade sunflower kernels, our clients benefit from lower processing scrap, enhanced flavor profiles, and consistent baking behavior. We trace each lot directly to certified agricultural holdings, ensuring full compliance with EU contaminant and pesticide thresholds.

sustainability-palm-oil.title: Sopreden’s Commitment to Sustainability: A Look into Our Palm Oil Production
sustainability-palm-oil.excerpt: Sustainability is no longer a corporate buzzword—it is an economic imperative. Discover how Sopreden ensures responsible sourcing and verifiable traceability.
sustainability-palm-oil.content:
In an era where sustainability is an essential prerequisite for global food and energy trade, Sopreden is proud to highlight its unwavering commitment to responsible sourcing and environmental stewardship.

Our palm oil fractions are sourced exclusively from certified mills that enforce zero-deforestation policies, protect high carbon stock peatlands, and champion fair labor standards. Whether intended for confectionery fillings, bakery emulsifiers, or renewable bio-diesel production, our customers receive comprehensive documentation confirming full chain-of-custody compliance.

sunflower-kernel-bakery.title: Sopreden’s Sunflower Kernel Bakery Grade: A New Favorite in the Baking Industry
sunflower-kernel-bakery.excerpt: Commercial bakeries demand kernels that don't scorch in industrial ovens and maintain crunchiness in multi-grain loaves. Here is why bakers choose Sopreden.
sunflower-kernel-bakery.content:
The commercial baking sector is continuously raising quality benchmarks. Industrial bakers and artisan pastry houses seek ingredients that elevate loaf aesthetics without adding processing headaches. Sopreden's Bakery Grade Sunflower Kernels have quickly emerged as an industry staple across Germany, France, and Scandinavia.

Sorted by dual-pass color cameras to eliminate broken particles and hull specks, our bakery kernels offer uniform count-per-ounce, optimal moisture retention, and resilient crunch that survives high-temperature baking and freezing cycles.

sunflower-crude-oil.title: Sopreden Introduces Sunflower Crude Oil to Its Product Line
sunflower-crude-oil.excerpt: Agribusiness expansion announcement: Sopreden scales its portfolio with high-yield Sunflower Crude Oil tailored for refineries and industrial users.
sunflower-crude-oil.content:
Exciting news from our trading desk: Sopreden has formalized long-term crushing and supply contracts to add Sunflower Crude Oil (First Press & Solvent Extracted) to its official commodity lineup.

With high oleic and linoleic variations available, our crude oil boasts a phosphorus content below 15 ppm, minimal free fatty acids (FFA < 1.75%), and exceptional clarity. We offer deliveries in 24,000-liter sanitary flexitanks, dedicated road tank trailers, and coastal vessel cargo lots from Black Sea and Danube river ports.

boutiqueAdvantage.title: The Boutique Advantage — Why Precision Dehulling Outperforms Mega-Crushers
boutiqueAdvantage.subtitle: Unlike industrial mega-crushers that grind and pulverize seeds purely for crude oil extraction, Sopreden’s specialized facility is engineered exclusively for human-grade kernel preservation.

points.title: Gentle Kinetic Impact vs. Destructive Grinding
points.description: Our calibrated centrifugal rotors crack the outer fibrous pericarp without shattering the fragile inner seed embryo, preserving natural shape, crunch, and nutritional oils.

points.title: Custom Client Calibration on Demand
points.description: We fine-tune rotor velocity, sieve mesh dimensions, and optical camera thresholds for each client's specific moisture, broken tolerance (<3%), and count-per-ounce requirements.

points.title: Small-Batch Agility & Zero Cross-Contamination
points.description: Rapid changeovers and thorough clean-downs enable us to switch smoothly between striped confectionery sunflower, black oil seeds, and 'Lady Nails' pumpkin kernels.

points.title: Hyper-Local Danube Farm Proximity
points.description: Located directly in Bulgaria's premier sunflower basin, raw seeds arrive from farm gates within hours of harvest, preventing heat build-up and oxidative rancidity.

process.title: The 6-Stage Precision Dehulling Process
process.subtitle: A closed-circuit, automated engineering sequence ensuring 99.9% optical Sortex purity and maximum whole-kernel recovery.

steps.title: Pre-Cleaning & Destoning
steps.description: Multi-deck vibrating screens, permanent neodymium magnetic traps, and heavy-duty air aspirators remove dust, field debris, stems, and mineral stones.

steps.title: Precision Calibration & Sizing
steps.description: Cylindrical grading drums classify raw seeds by millimeter fractions so every individual seed receives the exact calibrated kinetic impact energy.

steps.title: Centrifugal Kinetic Impact Dehulling
steps.description: Calibrated seeds enter high-speed rotor impellers spinning against an elastomeric impact ring. The kinetic impact splits the outer shell cleanly without kernel bruising.

steps.title: Multi-Channel Air Aspiration
steps.description: Negative-pressure closed-circuit air streams fluidize the mixture, lifting the lightweight hulls away from the heavier nutritious meat kernels.

steps.title: Gravity Density Separation & Return Loop
steps.description: Multi-deck vibrating gravity tables separate residual unhulled seeds, automatically rerouting them into a secondary gentle dehulling loop.

steps.title: Optical Sortex Laser Color Sorting
steps.description: High-speed bi-chromatic optical cameras scan falling kernels, triggering compressed-air micro-jets to eliminate discolored seeds and hull fragments in milliseconds.
